newsitem.title: EGYPT: Medinet Nasr raises 95/96 dividend, profits.
newsitem.headline: Medinet Nasr raises 95/96 dividend, profits.

text.p: Blue-chip realty firm Medinet Nasr Housing and Development will give out a 10 pound dividend for financial year 1995/96 compared to 6.90 pounds in the previous financial year, corporate sources said on Sunday.
The financial year ends on June 30.

They said the firm, one of the state's most successful privatisations, would give out the dividend on November 14 but quashed rumours that it would also distribute a free share with the cash dividend.
Investors scooped up Medinet Nasr shares last week after the free share talk flooded the market.
The realty firms said in results made available on Sunday it raised net distributable profits for 1995/96 by 43 percent to 52.21 million from 36.53 a year earlier.
In July, the real estate firm also bought a controlling 65 percent stake in rival Cairo Housing and Development for more than 30 million pounds.
Investments in property and housing projects also rose to 7.32 million from 7.02 million in 1994/95. Bank deposits were also higher for 1995/96 at 153.73 million from 126.19 million.
In May, the state sold off 2.8 million shares or 70 percent of Medinet Nasr at 65 pounds a share. On Sunday, the firm's shares closed at 198 pounds.
